title: Don't fall in love with this Samsung heart-shaped phone. It's an AI fake.
excerpt: Samsung has gotten more creative with phone form factors, but not this creative.
content_html:
A heart-shaped Samsung phone is going viral online, with video of the device racking up thousands of likes and shares on both X and Instagram. Don't get too excited about it, though. The video is AI-generated, and the phone doesn't exist.

Video of a Samsung-branded, heart-shaped phone has been spreading on social media, depicting a person pulling protective plastic off the device inside a store. While many savvy social media users quickly deduced that the phone was an AI-generated fake, a few wondered if it was real or expressed excitement to buy it.

Unfortunately for lovers of whimsy, the heart phone is most definitely not real. The clip was originally posted to Instagram by @tanu_mobile, an account filled with AI-generated clips of fantastical tech products, and has accumulated 49.2 million views at time of writing. In addition to posting the fake heart-shaped Samsung phone, @tanu_mobile has also posted other AI-generated heart-shaped phones with Apple and Vivo branding within the last few days. 

Though none of these videos explicitly disclose that they were made with AI, the descriptions for some do say that the phones are "fanmade." @tanu_mobile also acknowledged that a previous video of a Samsung-branded heart phone which they'd posted weeks ago was AI generated. The use of generative AI is particularly clear in the video of the heart-shaped Vivo phone, in which a woman's clothes suddenly morph into an entirely different outfit.

Mashable Light Speed

The currently viral Samsung heart phone video has a few tells as well. Specifically, the Samsung signage in the reflection on the phone is misspelled, and its app names are garbled. Some of the app icons are giveaways too, as the device appears to have iOS' Phone, Notes, and Calendar apps installed. Samsung uses the Android operating system, so does not use these specific Apple apps.

Samsung has gotten slightly more creative with its phones' form factor recently with the new Galaxy Z Fold 8, a foldable with a shorter body than is typical of modern smartphones. Even so, there have been no reports that it's venturing into more novel shapes such as hearts at present.

While the Samsung heart phone may not exist, the video is a good reminder to be sceptical when scrolling, especially considering the prevalence of AI-generated videos. Question unusual and exciting new products before being swept up in the hype — particularly if there weren't even any rumours about them before they showed up on your For You feed.

content_html_zh:
一款心形的三星手机在网上疯传，该设备的视频在 X 和 Instagram 上获得了数千次点赞和分享。 不过，不要对此太兴奋。 该视频是人工智能生成的，而手机并不存在。

一款三星品牌心形手机的视频在社交媒体上流传，视频中一名男子在商店内从手机上撕下保护塑料。 虽然许多精明的社交媒体用户很快就推断出这款手机是人工智能生成的假货，但也有一些人怀疑它是否是真的，或者表达了购买它的兴奋。

不幸的是，对于喜欢奇思妙想的人来说，心脏电话绝对不是真实的。 该剪辑最初由 @tanu_mobile 发布到 Instagram，该帐户充满了人工智能生成的奇妙科技产品剪辑，在撰写本文时已累积 4920 万次浏览。 除了发布假冒的三星心形手机外，@tanu_mobile 在过去几天还发布了其他带有 Apple 和 Vivo 品牌的人工智能生成的心形手机。

尽管这些视频都没有明确透露它们是用人工智能制作的，但有些视频的描述确实说这些手机是“粉丝制作的”。 @tanu_mobile 还承认，他们几周前发布的三星品牌心脏手机的视频是人工智能生成的。 生成式人工智能的使用在心形 Vivo 手机的视频中尤为明显，其中一名女性的衣服突然变成了完全不同的服装。

可混搭光速

目前广为流传的三星心脏手机视频也透露了一些信息。 具体来说，手机倒影中的三星标牌拼写错误，其应用程序名称也出现乱码。 一些应用程序图标也是赠品，因为该设备似乎安装了 iOS 的电话、便笺和日历应用程序。 三星使用Android操作系统，因此不使用这些特定的Apple应用程序。

三星最近推出了新款 Galaxy Z Fold 8，其手机的外形更具创意，这款可折叠手机的机身比现代智能手机的典型机身更短。 即便如此，目前还没有报道称它正在尝试尝试心形等更新颖的形状。

虽然三星心脏手机可能不存在，但该视频很好地提醒人们在滚动时保持怀疑态度，特别是考虑到人工智能生成视频的流行。 在被炒作席卷之前，先对不寻常且令人兴奋的新产品提出质疑——尤其是在它们出现在您的 For You feed 上之前甚至没有任何关于它们的谣言的情况下。
